minor.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com
minor.comment: In RTL, a Sheet's `side` is the physical edge again, as in shadcn: `side="left"` opens on the left. To open from the start edge, pass `side={direction === "rtl" ? "right" : "left"}`. A Sidebar's mobile Sheet now opens from the same edge as the desktop Sidebar.
